scope: Step 1 source annotation only; no new training images or training run
coordinate_convention: x right, y down, zero-based pixel centres; normalized by1253
landmark_convention: Center of the speed crossbar at its inward rail endpoint

pivot.method: estimated rotation centre from visible hub

tip.method: centre of bright terminal needle feature

needle.shaft_mask_status: approximate regularized silhouette, review only; hub excluded

scale_arc.class_definition: Printed double-rail0-to180scale ribbon, including both rails and the gap
scale_arc.boundary_method: Robust radial fits to visible rail-edge intensity crossings between crossbars

uncertain_60_region.observed_arc_supervision: ignore pixels in this box; amodal completion is separate
uncertain_60_region.original_photo_assessment: 60region visible but low resolution; confirms identity/order, not exact pixels in regenerated master

limitations: Approved source is an AI reconstruction, not the original photograph; exact physical scale geometry is unverified.
Original photograph and approved master have different needle positions and framing.
Current source needle is not snapped to an inferred60tick and has no verified speed label.
Hidden arc completion and regularized shaft silhouette are not observed pixel ground truth.
Annotation uncertainty estimates are visual estimates, not statistical confidence intervals.
